title: Compact Quickstart Sprint — modular hero, inline diagrams, and progressive step tiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce a compact, above-the-fold Quickstart landing variant that reduces cognitive load and real estate while preserving discoverability for key actions. Deliverables: a modular hero (condensed headline, single-line explainer, subtle illustrative diagram), a set of 3 progressive step tiles (compact microcopy + icon + status affordance), and an inline system diagram that explains request flow (API -> model -> cache -> response). This variant will be the mobile-first baseline for docs landing and a candidate for an A/B test against the existing full-bleed hero. Constraints: brand-consistent, supports dark mode, accessible color contrast, exports for docs and marketing, and optimized for first-contentful-paint (SVG + minimal raster).
acceptance_criteria: Figma artboards for desktop/tablet/mobile exported and linked
SVG icons and hero illustration exported and optimized (gzip-ready)
Three-step tile component spec with spacing tokens and hover/focus states
Accessible color variants (normal + dark) passing 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for iconography
Implementation PR opened with screenshot diff and QA checklist attached
Analytics events defined for hero CTA click and step expansions
Final design reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng
